## Born in the Clouds

Skypieans, Birkans and Shandia all grew up on islands of cloud, with tiny wings that do not quite fly.

Be of the Sky People.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Be of the Sky People race

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +2 Training Points (your race)

Train Kenbunshoku Haki to 150. Birkan Mantra techniques have their own branch.

## Forfeit Your Wings

Become a Wingless Birkan: stronger grounded Mantra, no altitude bonus, and no use of wing-based movement.

Submit one Mine Mine no Mi Scissors. Cruise blacksmiths can forge these at level 10.

Tick the confirmation, then manually claim the reward named Forfeit your wings. Claiming it removes your wings immediately.

You may still BUY Sky Leap to satisfy the Mantra Mark prerequisite, but cannot USE Sky Leap without wings.

Restoration still requires an operator: /racenomi wings restore &lt;player&gt;.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Be of the Birkan race](r_sky_people.md#q-650e6cf908d740da), [The Birkan Choice](r_sky_people.md#q-5a30c73316a6a63e)

**Tasks**

- Submit 1 Scissors
- I choose to forfeit my wings; claiming the reward performs the change

**Rewards**

- Forfeit your wings (click to become Wingless Birkan)

<a id="q-216851f7015783b8"></a>

## The Dial Arts

Wyper's way: Skypiea's warriors fight with the shells of the sky, the dials, worn on their arms.

Take up the Dial Arts: find a master of the school (a mentor; sneak and talk to them) and be taken in. Any fighter can learn it. The school teaches its techniques for nothing as your Doriki grows; the ability tree shows them, but only the school opens them.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Be taken into the Dial Arts

**Rewards**

- Doriki +150, Belly +5,000

<a id="q-661e88492e445c2b"></a>
